notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Financial figures are from GE's FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000040545-25-000015), checked against SEC XBRL; the company completed the GE Vernova spin-off on April 2, 2024 and now operates as GE Aerospace. Ownership is from the 2025 proxy (DEF 14A filed March 13, 2025, accession 0001308179-25-000114), as of December 31, 2024. LEADER: Larry Culp (H. Lawrence Culp, Jr., Chairman and CEO) beneficially owned 1,210,834 shares, marked ** (less than 1%), so pctEconomic is null; 1,082,501 of these are held with shared voting and investment power through family trusts or other accounts. HOLDERS: the proxy gives only the 13G filing dates (Vanguard February 13, 2024; BlackRock January 31, 2025; Fidelity February 9, 2024), not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null. Capital International Investors (5.1%) is the fourth 5% holder and is not listed (max 3). STOCK COMP, JUDGMENT CALL: the 10-K's only stated share-based compensation expense is after-tax ($286 million, the XBRL-tagged figure). The pre-tax expense is not stated; the note gives a related income tax benefit of $152 million, and the statement of changes in shareholders' equity shows 'Stock-based compensation 361' (millions) credited to other capital. The after-tax figure is used as reported and understates the pre-tax cost; it is not grossed up. GEOGRAPHY: the 'Total Non-U.S.' subtotal ($21,363 million) is omitted to avoid double counting; non-U.S. revenue was 55% of the total.
